FloPlast RGS3W uPVC square gutter, in white and measuring 114mm by 3m, provides an effective solution for rainwater management. Its robust uPVC construction, featuring a rectilinear profile and high gloss finish, ensures both durability and a clean aesthetic. The gutter delivers good all-round weathering and maintains excellent colour fastness over time. Installation is streamlined and fast, thanks to a pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip system, which reduces labour for tradespeople and DIYers. This guttering is a practical choice, suitable for new build projects and refurbishment applications, offering reliable performance and minimal upkeep for property owners.
